system.description:
You take a boxers stance, when you are confronted by a melee attack from a creature within 5 feet of you.

Until the beginning of your next turn, each melee attack that targets you, you can spend 4 chakra. When you do, you attempt to duck and weave granting yourself a +2 Bonus to your AC against the triggering creature and then immediately make one unarmed attack in response to the triggering melee attack.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank increase the activation cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank, increase the AC bonus by +1.

trigger.text: 1 Reaction, which you take damage from a melee attack or when a creature misses you with a melee attack.
